input.brief: The Health Blueprint: nine interactive experiments showing teenagers how everyday habits change the body's systems

direction.name: The printed annual
direction.idea: Lay the page out like a well-designed printed report or magazine feature: a masthead image, a tight oversized title, text held to a strict column line, and colour used in solid blocks the way a two-colour print job would. It gives weight and authority to subjects that are really about content: findings, a manifesto, a programme, a serious product. The reader should feel that someone edited this.
direction.composition: A fixed vertical axis at about 42% of the viewport width organises everything: headings begin on it, body columns hang from it, and the 0–42% zone holds small side notes, figures or stays empty. Masthead: a wide image band (photographic mosaic or a single crop) across the top 45% of the first screen; below it the title at 7–9vw starting on the axis, with a two-sentence standfirst at 20–24px. Sections alternate between text pages (title on the axis, body in one or two columns of 34–40ch to its right) and full-bleed colour pages carrying one large figure, quotation or image mosaic. Mosaics are gutterless: photographs and flat colour tiles butted together in a 4- or 6-cell grid. Page numbers, running heads and other print furniture are left out.
direction.typography: A tight heavy grotesk or a sharp serif for titles; an excellent text face for reading at 18–20px with leading near 1.5. Headings in sentence case, tracked tight.
direction.colour: Paper, ink and two or three solid block colours. A colour page is a whole section in one flat colour.
direction.imagery: Photographs used as blocks in mosaics alongside flat colour tiles; mixed subjects are fine if cropped tight and converted to one treatment.
direction.photoTreatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.
direction.richness: The column line, the mosaics and whole pages of colour give structure and variety without ornaments.
direction.pitfalls: The axis must be exact and reused everywhere or it reads as random indentation. Keep paragraphs to a real reading measure. On a phone the axis collapses to the left margin and side notes move inline above their paragraph.

hero.name: Two-by-two board
hero.blueprint: A board with 8px outer margins and 8px gaps throughout; every tile is a filled rectangle with one shared radius (0 or 8px). A 60px top row is itself made of tiles: a square ink tile with the logo mark, a wide ground-tone tile holding four text links that begin at the centre line, and an ink tile at the right end holding the single action. Below it the rest of the viewport is a two-by-two grid. Top-left: a paper tile with the name, or its first word, at clamp(96px, 12.5vw, 190px), medium weight, tracking -0.05em, sitting bottom-left on 24px padding. Top-right and bottom-left: photographs covering their tiles (object-fit: cover), both greyscale so they read as one picture continued across the board. Bottom-right is divided into two tiles side by side: a dark tile with one sentence at 24px, top-left aligned, and a tile in the accent colour with a second short statement at 24px, also top-left. Text never centres inside a tile. No tile is empty and none is outlined.
hero.mobile: The board becomes one column of tiles with 6px gaps: a top row with the logo tile and a menu tile; the name tile at 30% of the screen height with the name at 22vw bottom-left; one photograph tile at 4:3; then the dark tile and the accent tile side by side as two squares. The second photograph moves below the first screen.
hero.headline: The name, or its first word, up to 8 characters at 12.5vw; the two 24px statements are one sentence each.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: One image across tiles
sections.blueprint: One photograph is cut across a board of tiles. A grid of six columns and four rows with 8px gaps spans the full width between 12px margins; every tile is square (aspect-ratio: 1). Each tile shows its own piece of the same image: set the photograph as every tile's background at background-size: 600% 400% and step background-position by column and row, so the picture reads whole through the gaps. Five of the twenty-four tiles are swapped for flat colour tiles from the palette, never two adjacent: one holds the heading (two to four words at 2.6vw, top-left, 16px padding), three hold one fact each at 18px, one holds the action. On hover a tile's piece scales to 108% inside its own clip. Choose a photograph with one clear subject, so the board is legible at a glance.
sections.mobile: Three columns by six rows with 6px gaps, the photograph re-cut at background-size 300% 600% from a portrait crop. Four colour tiles only; the heading tile spans two columns in the top row with the heading at 6vw. Facts drop to 15px.

sections.name: Day tabs, banded agenda
sections.blueprint: A two-line heading at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px), first line in the soft ink and second in full ink, with the booking button on the same row at the far right. 56px below, left: a 150px column of stacked day tabs, each a filled block 150 by 64px with 6px gaps showing the weekday at 16px and the date at 13px; the active tab takes the darkest fill with inverted text. Right, from 190px to the right margin: the day's sessions as alternating tone bands, each 76px tall with an 8px radius and 4px gaps, the two tones one step apart. Inside a band, on fixed column starts: the time at 20px with tabular figures, 20px from the left; the title at 18px in medium weight at 22%, with a one-line note at 13px in the soft ink under it; speaker names right-aligned at 14px beside up to three overlapping 32px round portraits.
sections.mobile: The heading stacks above a full-width button. Day tabs become a horizontal row of equal filled blocks, sticky under the top edge. Each band stacks time over title over speakers with 16px padding and grows to fit; portraits sit at the band's top-right corner.

sections.name: Recognition as a table
sections.blueprint: Awards, press mentions or credits set as a four-column table with no lines. The heading is two or three words at about 5vw, stepped over two lines with the second line indented by two columns, and occupies columns 1–7. The table begins 72px below and spans columns 1–12 on a fixed grid: year in columns 1–2, project or title in 3–6, awarding body or publication in 7–10, the award itself in 11–12, right-aligned. Rows are set at 16–17px with 14px of padding above and below; every second row carries a background tone one step from the ground, running the full table width, which replaces rules. Year groups are separated by one blank row, and the year is printed only on the first row of its group. Use a real `<table>` with `border-collapse: collapse` and no borders.
sections.mobile: The heading drops to 11vw. Each table row becomes a two-line block: title on the first line in the full ink, then body and award on the second in the softer ink. The year stands once as a 22px figure above its group. Alternate blocks keep the background tone.

sections.name: Contact as the headline
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed field in one saturated palette colour, at least 90svh tall. Top row, 40px from the edge: two or three short notes at 15px in columns 1–7 (address, hours, a one-line description) and a back-to-top text link at the right margin. Then a tall empty gap. In the lower half, the way to get in touch is the display line: the telephone number or the email address itself, set at 8–9vw, flush left, hard against the margin, as one link. An email address may break once, before the @, giving two lines. Size it with `clamp()` so the longest line fills at least 80% of the width. Under it, one row of small text at 14px spread across three positions: links at the left, credits in the centre, city and year at the right. The wordmark appears only small, in the top row.
sections.mobile: Notes stack at the top at 15px. The contact line sits in the lower half at 12vw; a telephone number stays on one line, an email breaks before the @ and is sized so each half fits the width. The meta row becomes three stacked lines at 13px.

references.name: The Queue
references.idea: An essay on queueing where the queue is the ornament: a line of drawn figures stands along the bottom of the hero and returns between chapters in changing period dress.
references.hero: Pinkish warm-grey page. A 12px mono breadcrumb sits top-left; there is no other navigation. The two-word title is set in a light serif at 200px (14vw), centred, its middle slightly above the viewport centre, spanning about 60% of the width with tight tracking. One centred line of grey 20px serif sits 40px beneath. The lower third stays empty until a single row of about 25 small greyscale drawn figures, each around 110px tall, stands on a hairline rule 20px above the bottom edge and runs the full width like a frieze.
references.type: Newsreader does everything: Light at 200px with -0.05em tracking for the title, regular near 30px for chapter headings, 18px body with open leading, and pale ghost numerals around 22vw. A monospace appears only in the breadcrumb and footer labels.
references.colour: #ebe4e0 #2b2622 #6f6763 #d9d2ce #16a05a — One warm rosy-grey ground throughout, brown-black text, mid-grey secondary lines, greyscale drawings. A single green appears only in the breadcrumb and one footer button.
references.imagery: Hand-drawn greyscale figures with fine outlines, standing in single file on a hairline; each band changes era costume and spacing. No boxes or backgrounds: figures sit directly on the page colour, full width.
references.layout: After the centred hero, text runs in one narrow column about 40% of the viewport wide, starting 30% from the left; the right third holds only a huge pale chapter numeral. Chapters are separated by full-width bands of figures on hairlines.

sections.description: Chapter block. A 30px serif question heads a text column about 590px wide, offset 30% from the left. Behind it in the top-right corner sits a chapter numeral roughly 22vw tall in a tint barely darker than the page, cropped by the section's top edge. Body is 18px serif at about 1.8 leading; bold run-in phrases open key paragraphs in place of subheads. No pull quotes, side notes or images inside the text.

Divider band between chapters: a full-width strip about 180px tall in which 10 to 15 drawn figures stand at uneven intervals on a 1px rule, with 120px of empty page above. The number and spacing of figures follow the story (few and scattered early, an evenly spaced orderly line later), so the divider carries part of the argument instead of acting as a spacer.

The ending switches voice. A white rounded promo bar with a blue pill button, then a heavy sans heading with a short grey paragraph and one green button, then a hairline, a mono uppercase label, and four small white cards in a row (thumbnail, mono number, bold title). It is narrower than the page and sits on a different axis from the essay column, so it reads as site furniture attached afterwards.

steal: Turn the subject into the section divider: a frieze of small figures on a hairline, redrawn for each chapter, in place of rules or spacers.
Set one serif family at three far-apart sizes (200px title, 30px heading, 18px body) and mark chapters with a pale 22vw numeral cropped off the corner.
Hold body text to a narrow column offset left of centre and leave the right third empty instead of filling it with sidebars.

references.name: Applied Imagination
references.idea: An essay conceived on a flight is read as a descent: an altimeter ticks from 30,000 ft to zero while you scroll down through halftone clouds to mountains at ground level.
references.hero: A pale blue sky fading to warm cream fills the viewport, with white clouds shaded in halftone dots. A tiny serif logotype sits top-centre; no nav. The title, two centred lines of black wedge-serif at 8.9vw, occupies the middle half of the screen and about 73% of its width; a cloud layer passes in front of the second line's baseline so the feet of the letters dissolve into dots. A two-line centred deck at 24px sits beneath. A mono byline strip is centred on the bottom edge with a scroll cue bottom-right. On the left edge at mid-height, a short vertical rule carries a two-line mono altitude readout.
references.type: fsKim, a sturdy wedge-serif display face, regular weight at 128px with -0.01em tracking for the title and pull quotes; gtAmerica at 24px for the deck and about 16px for essay body; gtAmericaMono uppercase around 11px with wide tracking for byline, altitude and tape labels.
references.colour: #cbe4f2 #f1e3b5 #0a0a0a #ffc013 #8e2f8f #f04e23 — Sky blue melting into sand yellow is the constant ground and text is black. Saturated magenta, orange and yellow arrive only in collage objects, tape labels and the footer contact card.
references.imagery: Photo-collage cut-outs (parachutes carrying a treasure chest and a burning dumpster, a pair of legs, mountains) given a coarse halftone dot screen, layered in front of and behind the type against painted clouds.
references.layout: A narrow text column about 38% wide for essay passages, interrupted by full-width display pull quotes and collage objects floating at the edges. One continuous sky instead of sections, with a fixed left-edge altimeter. Nearly 23 screens, ending on a ground-level landscape.

sections.description: Sky background, no container. A three-line pull quote in black wedge-serif at about 7vw is centred and tightly leaded. Two cut-out parachutes hang over it: a magenta one from the top-left carrying a chest spilling coins, an orange one at lower right carrying a burning dumpster, each overlapping letterforms. Small mono labels on tilted strips of coloured tape are stuck to the objects. Words in the quote turn from grey to black as they are reached.

Running essay text in about 16px grotesk, black, in a single column roughly 38% of the viewport wide, positioned left of centre with large sky margins on both sides. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line; serif sub-statements at about 28px introduce passages. The next display quote is seen rising from below, its letters partly hidden behind cloud and blurred.

Ground level: halftone-screened mountains in green and brown rise from both sides, and the title returns at huge scale, cropped by the top edge and tucked behind the peaks. Centred below is a square-cornered two-panel card: a cream left panel with a short form of two fields and a small orange button, and a magenta right panel with a round portrait, name and a yellow subscribe button. Yellow tape-strip credits sit on the bottom edge.

steal: Tie a persistent numeric readout to scroll position (altitude falling to zero) so the reader's progress becomes part of the story.
Layer an illustration element in front of the bottom of a giant title so the letters sink into the scene instead of sitting on top.
Apply one coarse halftone dot screen to every photo cut-out so collage pieces from different sources read as one illustration set.
